definitions.explanation: The process of becoming warmer, especially in reference to climate.
The increase in Earth's average temperature due to greenhouse gases. Usually used with 地球.

examples.japanese: {温暖化|おんだんか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
{温暖化|おんだんか}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{短|みじか}くなった→短い：00510_mijikai⟧。
examples.english: Winters have gotten shorter due to warming.

notes:
{温暖化|おんだんか} is typically used in the compound ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧{温暖化|おんだんか} (global warming).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}→地球：03461_chikyuu⟧{温暖化|おんだんか} - global warming
- {温暖化|おんだんか}⟦{対策|たいさく}→対策：02511_taisaku⟧ - measures against warming
- {温暖化|おんだんか}の⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧ - effects of warming
- {温暖化|おんだんか}が⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧ - warming progresses
- {温暖化|おんだんか}を⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧ - to prevent warming

WORD FORMATION:
⟦{温暖|おんだん}→温暖：02596_ondan⟧ (warm) + {化|か} (change/transformation suffix) = {温暖化|おんだんか}
